newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Oman cuts Feb selling price of crude to $19.72.
newsitem.headline: Oman cuts Feb selling price of crude to $19.72.

text.p: Oman has set the official selling price (OSP) of Oman crude for February lifting at $19.72 per barrel, down from $22.50 in January, traders said on Monday.
Oman sets its monthly crude prices for term contract buyers retroactively and in line with international spot market trends.
Traders said the Oman OSP narrowed the differential to the published average of Dubai for March to $1.05 per barrel, from a month-earlier $1.14.
Traders use the differential as a guide for the relative value of Middle East crudes.
